assessment.objective: Complete the benchmark by achieving a joint terminal state in which at least one available robot reaches any_targets|0 and at least one available robot reaches TARGET_any_targets|0.
constraints: The mission concerns the shared multi-floor scene with the available legged Spot and wheeled Fetch robots.
The terminal condition is joint: a robot must be at any_targets|0 and a robot must be at TARGET_any_targets|0.
assumptions: Reaching the object and reaching the goal receptacle position are the only required effects; pickup, transport, handoff, or confirmation is not additionally required.
Robot assignment and coordination are delegated to the system, as requested.

assessment.objective: Ensure that the joint terminal state holds in the shared multi-floor scene: at least one available robot reaches any_targets|0, and at least one available robot reaches TARGET_any_targets|0.
constraints: Operate within the shared multi-floor scene using the available legged Spot and wheeled Fetch robots.
The user delegates robot selection and division of work between the two robots.
The required terminal condition is jointly: a robot is at any_targets|0, and a robot is at TARGET_any_targets|0.
assumptions: The two reach conditions may be satisfied by the same robot or by different robots; the system may choose the assignment that achieves the joint terminal state.
No object transport, manipulation, handoff, or confirmation beyond reaching the two specified locations is required.
